brief.note: Quiet midweek; nothing new cleared 10%. Both names have bounced off their post-earnings lows.

candidates.name: DICK'S Sporting Goods, Inc.
candidates.business: Largest US sporting goods retailer, now also owner of Foot Locker
candidates.cause: Q2 missed on both lines and full-year sales and profit guidance was cut, with losses at newly acquired Foot Locker driving the shortfall.
candidates.right: Foot Locker's losses must narrow on schedule without further cuts to guidance
candidates.wrong: The Foot Locker acquisition keeps draining profit while athletic footwear demand stays weak

candidates.name: Advance Auto Parts, Inc.
candidates.business: Retailer of vehicle replacement parts to DIY customers and professional garages
candidates.cause: Q2 sales of $2.00bn missed the $2.04bn expected and comparable sales fell as tight household budgets hit DIY demand, though adjusted EPS beat.
candidates.right: DIY demand must stabilise so the raised profit guidance survives a second weak quarter
candidates.wrong: Consumer spending weakens further and the long-running turnaround stalls again on falling comparable sales
